The orchestrator has already run and recorded npm run test (1035/1035), check-contrast (50/50), codegen:check (0) and the Playwright suite (14 passed; 2 pre-existing failures on main outside this PR's surfaces) in docs/plans/split-ui-cycle/slice-5-evidence/pr-b/build-orchestrator-runs.md; read it and treat those as measured fact.
lens_task: Lens: MUTATION LEDGER. For every new or changed test in the diff, prove it can go red: apply a small reversible mutation to the code it pins (edit the source, run the narrowest test command that covers it, restore the file from `git show HEAD:<path>`), and record observed RED or GREEN in `mutations`. For a behavior the spec pins that has no test, record the mutation you would apply, observed NOT_RUN, and raise a finding. Frontend: `npx vitest run <spec file>` from frontend/. Backend: `dotnet build RunCoach.slnx --no-restore` from backend/ for compile-level claims; no backend test runs in this sandbox (the test host cannot create its named pipe): observe NOT_RUNNABLE_IN_SANDBOX with that error quoted and put the exact `dotnet test --project tests/RunCoach.Api.Tests/RunCoach.Api.Tests.csproj --no-build --filter-class <FullName>` command into orchestrator_runs. Then list, per changed file, what it mutates (state, events, wire shapes, tokens, routes) and attack each mutation: what breaks if the value or order were wrong, and does the code defend it. Finish with every gate the report claims, re-run: `npm run build`, `npx eslint <changed ts/tsx>`, `npx prettier --check <changed>`, `dotnet build --no-restore`, `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` on changed .cs files.
